subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the rendering style of <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>: an aged tempera fable painting on an old wood panel: cracked, faded pigment with fine craquelure, soft muted color, folk storybook composition and visible dry-brush texture.
<Subject 2> is the abandoned town street in both pictures: a narrow street of old plaster and adobe houses with clay-tile roofs, wooden shutters and doors, completely empty of people.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing a pale hazy morning view down the narrow empty street, clotheslines strung between the houses carrying white shirts and long dresses that billow in the wind as if invisible people were still wearing them, a church bell tower at the far end.
<Picture 2> is the last frame of [Shot 1], showing the same empty street at blue dusk, misty, with wet cobblestones, every window on both sides glowing warm yellow behind thin curtains, lamp posts fading toward the vanishing point.

detailed_description:
The target video is a living aged tempera painting in <Subject 1>: the cracked pigment and dry-brush texture stay visible on every surface as it moves, and the light changes like paint glazing over paint.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The white shirts and dresses swell and billow on the clotheslines as if worn by invisible people, their sleeves lifting like arms. The camera glides forward down the middle of the street at a slow, steady speed in one continuous move. A long gust lifts the garments off the lines one after another, and they drift up over the rooftops like pale ghosts while the empty lines slip out of frame overhead as the camera passes beneath them. As the camera travels, the morning haze deepens into blue dusk, mist gathers low over the wet cobblestones, and the windows on both sides begin to glow warm yellow one after another behind thin curtains, though the street stays empty. The camera is still gliding forward as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.

overall_soundscape:
Wind moving through an empty street, cloth flapping and snapping on the lines, wooden shutters creaking. A distant church bell rings once, softly. As dusk falls, crickets begin and a single far-off marimba note fades into the wind.
